CoE-WWT 5G Test Lab
Access The Lab
Be at the forefront of communication technology and AI.

State-of-the-art 5G Test Lab is a facility located within ARTgarage Bengaluru to test and demonstrate innovations. Industry partners make their technologies available through this facility.

The lab is accessible to the innovation community comprising Startups, Academia and Industry – currently at nominal cost.

Resources Available
Bharat 5G Use Case Lab

One of the 100 Bharat 5G Labs (DoT’s initiative) is located in our facility. This is a Private 5G Network with a wide range of computation support and accessories for building and testing 5G based use cases around camera and analytics, XR/VR, IoT devices and drone systems.

View fullsize
Karnataka 5G Test Lab

A parallel Private 5G Network consisting of combination of commercial and open source solutions on the 5G infrastructure side. This is ideal setup for researchers and innovators focusing on 5G technology at the infrastructure side.

View fullsize
Private 5G Coverage at ARTgarage

Coverage of the test Private 5G network extends to the whole of ARTgarage indoor and outdoor area and supports testing of mobility / handover scenarios.

View fullsize
Indoor & Outdoor Sites

Indoor Area: 75,000 SQ FT

Outdoor Area: 5 Acres

Cutting-edge Lab Equipment

A look at the tools powering Karnataka's 5G research and innovation ecosystem, from base stations and software-defined radios to drones, edge compute servers, and XR headsets. Built to test, validate, and accelerate real-world 5G use cases.

Research Support & 6G

5G/ 6G Positioning Services

• NR UEs position estimated by gNodeB using round trip time
• UE Positioning to help RAN optimize its antenna and beam configuration to improve QoS and user experience
• Millimeter wave beamforming transceiver kits in use with 5G RAN

Integration of 5G with TSN
QoS analysis and evaluation of performance robustness in complex, distributed applications like autonomous robotics

Near real-time RIC (nRT-RIC) xApps
For performance monitoring of applications

Sensing Data Architecture prototype
Data collection, storage, processing using sensors and near real-time RIC

6G Standards Activity
• Standards proposals in collaboration with Nokia Bell Labs, white paper and proposals to TSDSI and B6G alliance

• Proposal on 6G sensing data architecture, data monetization and use cases with sensing data architecture such as FRMCS and NTN
